Is Julia with LatentClassCausal.jl available?

lcc_available.Rd

A cheap check used to guard the examples and vignette: TRUE if a julia executable is found and both LatentMixtures.jl and LatentClassCausal.jl are installed in its active environment (see latentmixtures::lm_available(), which this calls). It never fails; with the environment variable LATENTMIXTURES_REQUIRE_JULIA=true a FALSE becomes an error, so that guarded examples cannot be skipped silently in checks.

Usage

lcc_available()

Value

TRUE or FALSE.

Examples

lcc_available()
#> [1] TRUE
